name: Focused contribution
about: Claim a small documentation, conversion, example or interface improvement.
title: "Contribution: "
---

## User problem

Who is affected, what are they trying to do, and where do they get stuck?

## Proposed scope

Relevant guide, source files and existing checks:

One bounded change and any work deliberately deferred:

## Completion criteria

Describe the visible result, example input and cheapest meaningful verification.
Keep implemented behavior, connected checks and planned work distinct. For
examples, include redistribution terms and interpretation limits.

## Coordination

Say whether you plan to contribute the change or want help defining it. Follow
CONTRIBUTING.md for licensing, attribution and commit sign-off. Never include
credentials, private data or unpublished operational receipts.
